en.answer: If the Level of <<11539>> becomes 1 by the effect of <<11847>>, and then increases by 1 with the effect of <<9676>>, its Level will become 2.
en.question: While the first effect of <<11847>> is applying, if an <<11539>> on my side of the field has its Level increased by 1 with the effect of <<9676>>, what does its Level become?
en.title: While the first effect of <<11847>> is applying, if an <<11539>> on my side of the field has its Level increased by 1 with the effect of <<9676>>, what does its Level become?

ja.answer: 「<<11847>>」の効果によってレベルが1になっている「<<11539>>」に「<<9676>>」の『●そのモンスターのレベルを１つ上げる』効果が適用された場合、そのレベルは１つ上がり、2になります。
